list.name: deployment
list.label: Deployment
list.description: Usado apenas nos painéis de histórico/contagem de deploys; CPU, memória e restarts filtram por Namespace e Pod.

panels.title: Uso de CPU dos Pods (%)
panels.description: % relativo aos limites/requests declarados quando existirem no cluster; caso contrário usa 1 vCPU como referência para o painel continuar útil.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{job="cadvisor-kind", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", pod!="", namespace!="", container!="", container!="POD", image!=""}[5m])) / clamp_min((sum by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", resource="cpu", unit="core"}) or sum by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits_cpu_cores{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}) or sum by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", resource="cpu", unit="core"}) or sum by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests_cpu_cores{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}) or sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{job="cadvisor-kind", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", pod!="", namespace!="", container!="", container!="POD", image!=""}[5m])) * 0 + 1), 0.001)

panels.title: Memória por Pod (usada x total declarado)
panels.description: Total declarado = soma de limits de memória (contentores + init, p.ex. OTel injection), via kube-state-metrics; se não houver limits, usa-se requests. Pods sem manifests de recursos só mostram uso (cAdvisor).

targets.expr: sum by (namespace, pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{job="cadvisor-kind", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", pod!="", namespace!="", container!="", container!="POD", image!=""})

(((sum by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", resource="memory", unit="byte"}) + sum by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_init_container_resource_limits{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", resource="memory", unit="byte"})) or sum by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", resource="memory", unit="byte"}) or sum by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_init_container_resource_limits{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", resource="memory", unit="byte"}) or sum by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits_memory_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}) or sum by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_init_container_resource_limits_memory_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}))) or (((sum by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", resource="memory", unit="byte"}) + sum by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", resource="memory", unit="byte"})) or sum by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", resource="memory", unit="byte"}) or sum by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", resource="memory", unit="byte"}) or sum by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests_memory_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}) or sum by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests_memory_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"})))
